{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to avoid overestimating price spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in early periods (e.g., first 5 days) when historical mean reversion is strong.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1–2 days if true outcome is significantly higher than model forecast (overshoot after spike).",
    "Apply upward bias correction when sentiment > 0.25, especially if model underestimates recent highs.",
    "Cap forecast growth above 5% per day in high-sentiment periods to prevent overreaction.",
    "Use moving average of last 5 days’ true outcomes to smooth out short-term noise before forecasting.",
    "If model consistently underestimates true outcomes in the last 3–5 days, shift forecast upward by 2–5% for next period."
  ]
}
